_doc: Pinned capture fixture for the Phase-0a/realism verification sweep (eng-review #1). Makes before/after frames pixel-comparable and re-runnable. Overview/beauty frames are shot in REAL free-cam (enterFreeCam) and the play frame in REAL idle mode, so the sweep exercises the actual camMode gate (framing.js) rather than a hand-posed approximation.
procedure: Start server via launch.json config 'open-birdie-verify' (:8223) + scratchpad sink.js (:9100).
POST /api/load-course {"cached":"chambers-bay.json"}; then reload the page; wait ~13s for HD settle.
In the page: S = window.__birdie.scene; S.renderer.setAnimationLoop(null).

Per frame: setSize + postfx.setSize to captureSize; for 'free' frames S.enterFreeCam(true) then Object.assign(S.free, pose) + S._freeTargets(); for 'idle' set S.camMode='idle' + S._idleTargets(); copy camera to S.camPosT/lookT; call S._frame() (applies the real framing.js gate + postfx.render()); toDataURL('image/jpeg', q) and POST to http://localhost:9100/<name>.jpg.
free.pose = ground pivot in SIM coords (tx east, ty north) + dist(m) + pitch(deg) + yaw(deg, 0 = camera south of pivot looking north) + hOff(m).

frames.name: play
frames.note: address view at the active hole; aim line + readability-scaled ball MUST render here (gameplay-UI regression check)

frames.name: ov_south
frames.note: wide overview from the south looking north over the origin holes + ponds

frames.name: ov_high
frames.note: high wide survey; HD-patch/course-wide seam check

frames.name: pond
frames.note: the origin ponds; water material read + reflector check

frames.name: green
frames.note: a green complex close-in; fringe/collar + checker read

frames.name: green_close
frames.note: P2a: CLOSE green cam (~18m) to actually SEE the mow-line edge + collar — past ~45-70m the collar fades (gDistFade) and the far-photo takes over, so the dist:70 green frame cannot show a lit-turf edge change

frames.name: sand
frames.note: bunker close-in; sand material + (deferred) dot-screen read
